## Constraints

### Must

- Use existing Ryvo pink, violet, gold, surface, radius, and motion tokens
- Show only native storefront localized real-money prices
- Keep gift artwork catalogue-driven and replaceable without business-logic changes

### Avoid

- TikTok branding or copied gift artwork
- Continuous animation on historical gift messages
- Decorative complexity that slows chat scrolling

## Decisions

- **ryvo-coins-gifts-2026-08**: Use compact three-column gift tiles, an existing BottomSheet hierarchy, a gold balance surface, and separate branded gift cards instead of ordinary text bubbles.
- **ryvo-modern-messaging-2026-08**: Adapt the 21st Messaging Conversation structure into Ryvo's full-screen ChatScreen using grouped content-width bubbles, mobile ActionSheets, embedded reply previews, and the same read-only bubble renderer for the official Ryvo thread.
